title: NIR Spectrum Manager

author.name: milanone
author.field: Near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy / chemometrics, with CIE L*a*b* colorimetry (plant samples, e.g. Salicornia)

provenance.origin: github.com/milanone/NIRLab at 488a319f8399, github (github: topic:streamlit topic:spectroscopy archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A Streamlit app, with all text in Italian, that turns multi-block JDX NIR spectra in a project folder into SNV-corrected datasets: it screens outliers and duplicate reproducibility, runs PCA and Ward clustering, and fits a PLS model with leave-one-out validation against L, a or b colour values. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
